heading: PEACE BENEATH THE STONE
analysis: Family life introduces the sensory ecology of a prey-descended society, Taren's delayed reflex and Sava's institutional loyalties.
presentationDecision: Public sample: domestic opening and therapy only.

heading: THE SHADOW AT NOON
analysis: The ritualized predator exercise meets a real disruption; a delay becomes useful while crowd training reveals its limitations.
presentationDecision: Withhold attack resolution and physical harm.

heading: THIRTY-SEVEN ABSENCES
analysis: Grief and reclassification reveal the gap between a triggering event and its institutional causes.
presentationDecision: Withhold victims and discoveries.

heading: THE CHAMBER OF MEASURE
analysis: Birth permissions turn resource constraints into intimate choices; Sava negotiates forms unable to represent mercy.
presentationDecision: Selected deferral mechanism is safe, no family outcome.

heading: THE LOWER ARCHIVE
analysis: Seln reveals preserved threats and the historical instruments of peace; Vaor becomes an investigation.
presentationDecision: Only public world-guide conflict and impending investigation; secrets protected.

heading: THE NIGHT TRAIN
analysis: Travel exposes administrative invisibility and infrastructure faults among people classified as cargo.
presentationDecision: Only travel toward border and model discrepancy in film.

heading: THE SECOND VAOR
analysis: An unregistered community has its own institutions, mutual support and coercive pressures.
presentationDecision: Full local revelations and character developments withheld.

heading: THE NORTHERN DEPOT
analysis: Defense emerges through violence, negotiation and the conversion of a death into a symbol.
presentationDecision: Deaths and fighting outcomes withheld.

heading: THE FIRST FACE
analysis: A provisional protective organization changes social expectations, biological selection and prestige.
presentationDecision: Do not reveal organization's founding or subsequent selection.

heading: THE CHILD WITHOUT A NUMBER
analysis: Scarcity connects political legitimacy to ecological repair; protective claims deepen into personal and collective commitments.
presentationDecision: Personal decisions and unfolding confrontation withheld.

heading: THE GENTLE MIST
analysis: An allegedly nonlethal intervention produces catastrophe; rival descriptions divide the truth.
presentationDecision: Entire event and losses reserved for reading.

heading: DEAF LAKE
analysis: Battle turns the species' retreat reflex into a tactic and produces a spreading political code.
presentationDecision: Military outcome and intimate disclosures withheld.

heading: AFTER VICTORY
analysis: Emergency institutions persist; towers and public rituals make a new hierarchy visible.
presentationDecision: Time scale and consequences mentioned, specific outcomes withheld.

heading: THE CHARTER OF CONTINUITY
analysis: Administrative categories turn useful wartime functions into social ranks and inherited opportunity.
presentationDecision: Details and political arrangements withheld.

heading: THE LAW OF THE FACE
analysis: The protective code faces atrocities committed under its own language and authority.
presentationDecision: Atrocity, judgment and discovered evidence withheld.

heading: DARAN VEYR
analysis: Evidence brings manipulation into view, yet personal removal cannot undo the institutions it enabled.
presentationDecision: Identity revelation and resolution withheld.

heading: THE WHITE WINTER
analysis: Control of orbital infrastructure makes technical adjustments into political force.
presentationDecision: Mechanism's deployment, consequences and return mission withheld.

heading: THE CITY THAT REPAIRS ITS TRACES
analysis: The capital preserves a caring self-image while rendering distant suffering administratively legible.
presentationDecision: Specific negotiations and evidence withheld.

heading: THE GARDENS OF KINSHIP
analysis: Comfortable captivity complicates liberation, while archives reveal deeper continuity between opposing orders.
presentationDecision: Archive revelations and opening of gates withheld.

heading: THE SIEGE OF THE ROOTS
analysis: An alliance's promised liberation encounters shared infrastructure and incompatible political objectives.
presentationDecision: Siege losses and results withheld.

heading: THE CUSTODIAN
analysis: Power depends on preserving essential systems; victors must choose which instruments survive.
presentationDecision: Transfer and consequential choices withheld.

heading: THE TRIAL
analysis: The attempt to separate old and new regimes reveals continuity, scarce resources and repeated exceptions.
presentationDecision: Judgments and renewed emergency withheld.

heading: THE SON WITHOUT FEAR
analysis: Institutions transmit expectations through education, family prestige and constrained succession.
presentationDecision: Deaths, succession and individual destinies withheld.

heading: THE CHILDREN WHO LOOK AT THE SKY
analysis: A later generation inherits altered instincts and narratives while confronting an unknown beyond its institutions.
presentationDecision: Ending and external encounter wholly withheld.
